Name: Stardew Blur FIX (pixel perfect zoom)
Author: arexasly
Description:
[size=5][b]Crisp Scale[/b][/size]
Sharper world and UI when your zoom level or UI scale isn't 100%.

[b]⚠ AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod was written by an AI assistant (Claude), directed and tested by me. I am not an experienced C# programmer.[/*]
[*]It has [b]only been tested on my own setup[/b]: Windows 11, RTX 5070, 3840x2160, Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.4.0, with InfiniteZoom installed. It may not work, or may look wrong, elsewhere.[/*]
[*]Updates may be produced later if new problems are found, and those will also be AI-assisted. Please treat updates with the same caution and keep a backup of your saves.[/*]
[*]Split-screen is [b]untested[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[b]What it does[/b]
The game draws the world and UI to off-screen images and then scales them to your screen with a bilinear filter. When the scale isn't exactly 100%, that blur softens the pixel art and text. This mod replaces that final scaling step with sharper filtering.

[b]Filter modes[/b] (config or Generic Mod Config Menu)
[list]
[*][b]Off[/b] - vanilla behavior.[/*]
[*][b]Point[/b] - hard pixel edges. Perfect at clean scales, slight rounding at others.[/*]
[*][b]SharpBilinear[/b] - crisp for non-integer upscales above 100%. Below 100% it behaves like vanilla unless you choose Point.[/*]
[/list]You can apply it to the world and the UI independently.

[b]Getting pixel-perfect results[/b]
Sprites are drawn 4x inside the game, so the picture is perfectly clean when 4 x your scale is a whole number: any multiple of 25%.
[list]
[*]125% = 5 screen pixels per art pixel[/*]
[*]150% = 6[/*]
[*]175% = 7[/*]
[*]200% = 8[/*]
[/list]Other values (e.g. 165%) still look better than vanilla with Point, but have a little rounding. Type [b]crispscale_info[/b] in the SMAPI console to see how clean your current values are.

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip into your Mods folder so you have Mods/CrispScale/CrispScale.dll.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Uninstalling[/b]
Delete the Mods/CrispScale folder. It does not change save files or game files.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Does not touch the night lightmap, which stays smooth on purpose.[/*]
[*]Works alongside InfiniteZoom on my setup. If another mod also patches the game's final screen draw, the SMAPI log will name it.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher and content packs are unaffected, as far as I know.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known limitations[/b]
[list]
[*]Tested on one setup only.[/*]
[*]No performance improvement is claimed.[/*]
[*]At non-clean scales, Point sampling can show slightly uneven pixel widths, mainly noticeable at small scales while scrolling.[/*]
[*]SharpBilinear in split-screen falls back to vanilla filtering for fractional upscales.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Safety[/b]
If a game update changes the code this mod patches, it logs a warning and leaves the game unmodified. If it hits an error while drawing, it turns itself off for the session.

[b]Reporting problems[/b]
Please post your SMAPI log (smapi.io/log), your zoom and UI scale, resolution, and what looks wrong. Support is best-effort.

Extract the zip into your Mods folder

Note: Point filtering is more pixel perfect than Sharpbilinear but may introduce shimmering. To be addressed
